I cannot afford chemical fertilizer or improved seeds this season, as the prices are too high and my household needs to save money for food and other needs. I will spread manure from our goats and cattle on the plot before planting, and my children and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves as we have always done. Millet grows well with the rains that come, so I will not irrigate, and I do not use sprays because they are costly and millet does not suffer much from pests on our small plot.
